items.title: 52145_Andrew Blakeney oral history interview
items.q: everybody in that band is gone now. Gene's gone, Fields gone, Lee's gone.

ctx.x: On January 1, 1927 we caught the boat and came back to L.A.

That was a very interesting job; I can remember Gene Wright, he was one of the better piano players in Los Angeles at that time, but he wasn't very popular. He liked to play classics, he liked to run liked a man who all over the piano. But we/played rhythm, you know, backed us up on our horns, and we talked to him so much he'd get mad and then he'd play rhythm. Poor fellow is gone now; in fact, everybody in that band is gone now. Gene's gone, Fields gone, Lee's gone. Nobody left but me.
What was Honolulu like in those days?
